scope: Fixed local assessment using public SQuAD 2.0 development data, never an official hidden test or a model-unseen confirmation. The selected specialist deepset/roberta-base-squad2 was supervised on SQuAD 2.0 and its upstream model card reports performance on public dev. Project-local title/ID/exact-context/question exclusions do not undo upstream benchmark exposure, pretraining contamination, possible model selection on dev, or semantic near-duplicates. Calibration may select only the predeclared threshold; evaluation is one frozen-policy public-benchmark assessment. Results do not establish business deployment quality or independent algorithm confirmation. Once published/evaluated, future runs are reproductions.
